comment: Pinned SoundFont catalog for gbk. Single source of truth for scripts/fetch-soundfonts.mjs (download + sha256 verify), scripts/prepare-soundfonts.mjs (build staging + public/static/soundfont-manifest.json) and the app's SoundFont picker. delivery=bundled: copied into dist/static at build time (GitHub Pages + compose). delivery=server: too large to bundle; served on compose.grepawk.com from the persistent /var/www/gbk-composer/soundfonts/ dir at /soundfonts/ (see deploy/nginx.conf) and only listed in the manifest for compose builds (GBK_SOUNDFONT_SERVER=1).

fonts.description: Balanced GM/GS bank, 261 presets + 13 drum kits. The default.
fonts.label: GeneralUser GS
fonts.license: Free, unrestricted use — see licenses/GeneralUser-GS-LICENSE.txt (S. Christian Collins)

fonts.description: Compact GM bank (Tim Brechbill). Loads ~5x faster than the default — good on slow connections.
fonts.label: TimGM6mb (Light)

fonts.description: Large, detailed GM bank (Fluid R3, Frank Wen). Best fidelity; 148 MB download, compose.grepawk.com only.
fonts.label: FluidR3 GM (HQ)
fonts.source: https://github.com/ikskuh/zyclone (Git LFS blob; font is the Debian fluid-soundfont FluidR3_GM.sf2)
